name: Hypercubes Are Strictly Contained in Maximum Classes
scope: Finite graphs, using irredundant set-family representations where relevant.
statement: Every finite hypercube is a maximum class, and the inclusion is strict.
proof: The full family $2^{[n]}$ has VC dimension $n$ and meets its Sauer bound with $2^n$ members. The path $P_3$, represented by the chain $\{\varnothing,\{1\},\{1,2\}\}$, is maximum of VC dimension one but is not a hypercube.
